info.title: Voynich API
info.description: Public reads and unsigned transaction builds. No sessions or login. MODE=fixture serves isolated in-memory fixture sessions selected by X-Fixture-Session. Amounts and slots are decimal strings. Null mint means native SOL. Example fixture monetary values are not launch configuration.

post.summary: Estimate sealing costs and check create_model size before allocation
post.description: sizeBytes is ciphertext bytes, including authentication tags, up to 64 Weights accounts (~640 MiB). Optional uploadKeyCount (1 to 8, default 8) sizes temporary upload funding across parallel upload keys. Optional create metadata is CreateModelRequest without sizeBytes/uploadFundingLamports, with the initial Weights addresses (up to 8) required. Providing it returns compact manifestBytes, exact createTransactionBytes, wallet-safe createTransactionMaxBytes (1104) and canCreate before accounts are allocated; size verdict fields are null without metadata. Chain quotes read current rent exemptions and getFeeForMessage with zero priority price. Upload funding covers each 888-byte write across all upload keys, any attach_weights and seal_range transactions, each upload key rent minimum, extra-key self-sweep fees, and a seal-fee reserve. Extra upload keys self-sweep their remainders back to the owner before seal_model; the primary upload key remainder returns in the seal sweep. requiredUpfrontLamports includes temporary funding; estimatedCostLamports excludes the returned reserve. Grant fees, failed transactions and later fee changes are excluded. Fixture monetary values are illustrative and marked fixture=true; create size uses the same local wire calculation.
